summary: A quiet week for the machine and a loud one for its scorekeeping. Nothing human-driven landed: no stage ran, no dive changed, and the 20 FINAL dives still read 0 INVESTABLE, 19 WATCH, 1 TOO_LATE. What moved on its own: the shadow book graded for the first time (56 rows, 11-26 to 11-28). The 'too crowded, skip it' call was right on 26 of 55 names (47%), right at link level on 10 of 13 links, strongly right on AI chips and humanoids, and clearly wrong on Hormuz crude tankers (5 of 6 WRONG, the BWET fund +99 pts vs SPY); SPY fell 5 to 7% over those windows, which flatters every 'skip' call. One new indicator trip: ICE 178.49 tripped prediction-market S2 ('the federal lane survives'), on a theme with no investable seat. SPY bounced 5.6% (689.81 to 728.32). No name is a buy. WSP.TO trades inside its band (185.63 vs 170.05 to 211.71) but is held at WATCH by a failed placement audit; VRT came within 8.5% of its band on 11-20 and is now one day past review_by, with seven more dives due 11-29 to 11-30. Stale, named: radar paused 88 days, campaign 76 days, no heat or scenario write since 2026-09-14, two tripped scenarios (data-center S2, prediction-market S2) on August probabilities, the rare-earth card 68 days past review. NVDA and ORCL market files still end 11-20. No RADAR-DEGRADED line. Click queue: EMPTY (live version 1795267820-8897 read directly, queue_check NOT ATTRIBUTED; queue and edits blocks both empty). Feeds 18 of 20 (Federal Reserve fifth digest running, Guardian World new). Deferred backlog 132 OPEN by `status: OPEN` regex, file unchanged since 11-19.

triggers.metric: Q3 2026 organic revenue growth against the guided floor (guide 34% to 36%)
triggers.note: Replaces the draft's falsifier, which required a print at or above the guided CEILING and so could not fire inside the guided range. The FY2026 guide needs the back half to grow about 45% after Q2 2026 printed 24.1% reported, so the guide's own floor is the honest test.

triggers.metric: Deferred revenue balance, from $3,633.7M at 2026-06-30
triggers.note: A falling balance converts today's free cash flow into a working-capital headwind and confirms the prepayment wave was one cycle. A balance still compounding by 2027 makes it structural and this becomes a materially better business than the bear case allows.

triggers.metric: Gross margin, which was flat at 36.32% in FY2025 against 36.62% in FY2024
triggers.note: The bull case needs pricing power; the record shows SG&A dilution. A sustained break above 37.5% is the first evidence that capture is price rather than scale, and it is the single fact that would move this toward INVESTABLE on fundamentals rather than on price.

triggers.metric: Share price, the level at which the 5-year and 10-year reverse-DCF conventions straddle the 15.7% to 18.3% defensible band instead of bracketing it 65% apart
triggers.note: At $175 the 5-year convention implies 22.5% and the 10-year 13.2%, so the two readings sit either side of the defended band rather than one at 32.95% and the other at 18.33%. Stated as a straddle rule and not as a valuation: it is a rule for when the horizon convention stops being load-bearing, which is a weaker and more honest claim than a fair value.

triggers.metric: EMEA organic revenue, which fell 14.8% in H1 2026 against the Americas' +31.0%
triggers.note: Carried over from the draft's leading indicator and unchanged by the attack. A 19% five-year path that is entirely Americas is regional, not structural.

triggers.metric: Quarterly total backlog growth (T&D plus C&I combined), YoY, as disclosed each 8-K
triggers.note: Backlog grew 19.6% YoY to a record $3.16 billion at 2026-06-30. A drop back under 15% YoY at the Q3 2026 release would say the current acceleration was a pull-forward rather than a sustained AI and grid-capex wave, and it is the cleanest available read on whether the 7.0% implied five-year FCF CAGR is even the right bar to clear.

triggers.metric: Consolidated GAAP operating margin, quarterly, as disclosed each 8-K
triggers.note: H1 2026 ran 6.37% consolidated (Q2 alone 6.28%), the highest in the company's visible 2018 to 2025 annual record (prior high 4.75% in FY2021). A print below 6.0% in Q3 or Q4 2026 would say the H1 improvement leaned on the favorable job close-outs management itself named rather than on a durable mix shift, and would undercut the operating_margin row in the gap table below.

triggers.metric: MYRG weekly close against 288.85, the 2026-04-07 close and the last print before the 2026-04-08 breakout leg that produced the 501.13 peak
triggers.note: RED TEAM AMENDED. The draft's level of $260 appears nowhere in data/market/MYRG.json and was invented, and its stated basis, a '2026-07-17 to 2026-07-24 pre-earnings low band (390.32 to 407.40)', is wrong on its own dates: the actual close range over that window is 379.17 to 409.07, and the band's floor is already 24.57% above today's 294.42, so it could not describe a further leg down. The replacement level is computed from the series: 294.42 is 1.93% above the 2026-04-07 close of 288.85 and already BELOW the 2026-04-08 close of 300.43, so the entire April-to-June leg that produced the peak has essentially round-tripped. Only two closes since 2026-04-08 sit below 300.43 and both are in the last four sessions. A sustained weekly close under 288.85 says the unwind has moved past that leg and is working on the 2025 advance from the 173.81 low; the next marker below it is 221.80, the lowest 2026 close (2026-01-08). This trigger is close to firing by design, and that proximity is itself the finding.

triggers.metric: PCS coverage resolution: axis-b analyst_count, and a control-probe-passed axis-a print once the unreadable fixture is fixed

triggers.note: This dive deliberately leaves issuer-level crowdedness unresolved rather than picking the flattering axis. A clean signal in either direction, more coverage arriving (genuine discovery under way) or a properly gated dark score (confirming genuine neglect), replaces a guess with a measurement.

triggers.metric: Quarterly operating cash flow to net income ratio
triggers.note: FY2025's 2.7578x OCF to net income is flagged in this dive's earnings-quality section as probable working-capital timing rather than durable conversion. A sharp reversal toward or below roughly 1.0x over two consecutive quarters would confirm that read; staying elevated above 1.5x through Q3 2026 would say the cash generation is more durable than the historical pattern (0.78x to 2.88x across FY2022-2025) suggests.

triggers.metric: Contract liabilities (合同负债), consolidated balance, CNY
triggers.note: THE trigger. Reported at 538,788,644.17 on 2025-12-31 against 1,118,911,017.44 on 2024-12-31, a 51.85% fall, in the issuer's own 2025 annual report. This is the input that produces the grade-C cap and it is also the forward-revenue tell for a long-cycle equipment maker funded by customer advances. NOT satisfied at the time of writing: the latest reported balance is 46.1% below the level, and the level itself is one this company held only twelve months earlier, so it is reachable rather than a stretch. Next observable at the 2026 interim balance sheet and at the FY2026 annual report.

triggers.metric: FY2026 tunnel-boring-machine segment new contracts and awards (掘进机板块新签/中标), CNY
triggers.note: FY2025 TBM intake was 6.372bn (2025 annual report, which also states 掘进机板块新签/中标 63.72 亿元 against a group total of 134.02 亿元). H1 2026 TBM intake was 3.961bn, which is 62.2% of the whole of FY2025 and annualises to 7.922bn, 24.3% ABOVE this level. The H1 2025 TBM split is not disclosed in any source fetched this run, so the seasonality behind the annualisation is unknown.

triggers.metric: Share price, CNY
triggers.note: The minimum close in the whole 533-row series in data/market/688425-SS.json, the 2024-09-18 close of 3.35, which is 17.9% below the 2026-09-01 close of 4.08. Not an invented level and not already satisfied. AMENDED by the red team 2026-09-02, which stressed the level instead of accepting it as a monitoring line: at 3.35 the market capitalisation is 17,867.2m and, against net cash of 1,098.3m, the enterprise value is 16,768.9m, so EV over the filed base free cash flow falls from 20.30x to 16.47x and, through the same solve the filed column uses, the implied five-year FCF CAGR falls from 8.45% to roughly 3.5%. That would take the gap from -7.88pp to roughly -2.9pp, from three times this file's own 2.60pp horizon band to about 1.1x it. So a 17.9% drawdown does most of the work of closing the valuation gap, which is MORE than the draft claimed for this trigger. What it cannot do is lift the verdict: grade C caps at WATCH at any price, so this trigger resets the entry question and does not answer it, and no entry zone is drawn at any of these levels.
